paper.title: Adapting to Decision-Relevant Non-Stationarity in Decentralized Heterogeneous Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Decentralized heterogeneous non-stationary bandit with dynamic consensus regret (known gap lower bounds)
unmapped: N heterogeneous agents with agent-specific oblivious time-varying means; regret measured against the agent-average best common arm
local means may change arbitrarily often; only the best common arm switches S_dec times and global gaps are sign-stable within regimes
agents communicate over random time-varying graphs with flooding time D_G(delta) (learner uses D_G)
settings.definition_quote: There are $N$ agents and $K$ arms. At round $t$, agent $i$ pulls arm $A_{i,t}$ and observes bounded reward $X_{i,A_{i,t},t}\in[0,1]$ ... $R_T=\sum_{t=1}^T\sum_{i=1}^N\bigl(\mu_{i,a_t^\star,t}-\mu_{i,A_{i,t},t}\bigr)$.

a margin floor underline_Delta <= min_r Delta_min^(r)/2 is chosen (e.g. 1/T)
settings.definition_quote: Gap-Adaptive DRFC runs the active-set scan at level $k=0$ ... until either a unique winner is certified or $k$ reaches $k_{\max}$.
